abilities.name: Voodoo Ritual
abilities.description: Nazeebo's Basic Attacks and Abilities poison non-Heroic enemies, causing them to take 66 additional damage over 6 seconds. Questonly If a Minion dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, Nazeebo permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana.; trait

fields.type: Spell Damage / Bonus Health, Bonus Mana
fields.notes: If multiple Nazeebos are on a team, only one Voodoo Ritual can be active on a target. Any Nazeebo can refresh the duration of a Voodoo Ritual placed by other Nazeebos, but only the Nazeebo that last (re)applied it gains the stack. Damage over Time effect does not stack. Subsequent applications refresh the duration.

abilities.name: Corpse Spiders
abilities.description: Hurl a jar of spiders that deals 50 damage. If it hits at least one enemy, create 3 Corpse Spiders that attack for 38 damage. Spiders last for 4 seconds. Corpse Spider

fields.notes: Corpse Spiders are untargetable. Corpse Spiders follow the target until it dies or until they expire. Corpse Spiders' Basic Attacks apply Voodoo Ritual. Corpse Spiders can collide with themselves, Structures and unpathable terrain, but not with other units.

abilities.name: Zombie Wall
abilities.description: After 1 second, create a ring of Zombies surrounding the target area that deal 28 damage and last for 3 seconds. Zombie

fields.notes: 1) Approximate distance from center of the ring to the center of the Zombie units. Summons 9 Zombies. Zombies are treated as unpathable terrain. Zombie Wall can be canceled by reactivating the Ability.

abilities.name: Plague of Toads
abilities.description: Create a wave of 3 Toads that explode on contact, dealing 126 damage over 6 seconds. This effect stacks. Stores up to 2 charges.; 8 / 0.5

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Damage over time, Summon figment, Skillshot
fields.notes: Toads at the edges are aligned 18.4 degrees to both sides from the target point. Each Toad applies 1 stack of DoT to all enemies hit by the explosion. Each enemy can be afflicted by a maximum of 20 stacks of DoT at a time. Stacks of DoT tick independently and subsequent applications do not refresh the duration of existing DoTs. Toads change direction upon coming into contact with unpathable terrain. Toads explode upon reaching maximum range, even if they didn't come in contact with an enemy.

abilities.name: Gargantuan
abilities.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area for 20 seconds. Deals 100 damage when summoned, attacks for 140 damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 140 damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds. Gargantuan ; 70; 90; heroic

fields.notes: Cooldown starts when Gargantuan is cast. Gargantuan takes 50% less damage from Forts, Keeps, and Towers (but not Core). This damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with the 50% damage reduction these Structures have to all Summons, so Gargantuan takes 75% less damage from them than other units do.

abilities.name: Gargantuan Stomp
abilities.description: Order the Gargantuan to stomp, dealing 240 damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Replaces Gargantuan while Gargantuan is alive. Can be activated while Nazeebo is dead. The 0.25 second delay will stop all other commands Gargantuan does (premature cast will stop the Gargantuan's Basic Attack).

abilities.name: Ravenous Spirit
abilities.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.; 90; 100; heroic

fields.notes: Ravenous Spirit can be canceled after 1.5 seconds by reactivating the Ability. While channeling, Nazeebo has direct control of Ravenous Spirit's movement. Spirit can travel through unpathable terrain and Structures.

talents.name: Widowmakers
talents.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second. reward After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their Attack Damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Corpse Spiders 's damage.

_raw_fields: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second. reward After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their Attack Damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

talents.name: Pandemic
talents.description: Quest Hit Heroes with Plague Toads. After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads. reward After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

fields.notes: Upon quest completion, alignment of the inner toads is changed to 14 degrees and outer to 26.6 degrees from the target direction. Damage reduction stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Hero.

_raw_fields: Quest Hit Heroes with Plague Toads. After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads. reward After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Each enemy hit by the initial explosion applies the effect. Subsequent hits extend the duration by 1.5 seconds each. Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Superstition
talents.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

fields.notes: Bonus is suppressed for 3 seconds even if the Spell Armor wasn't active when the Basic Attack hit. Corpse Spider is only spawned if the Spell Armor buff was active at the time the Basic Attack hit. Corpse Spider spawns by Nazeebo and then chases the target. Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

fields.notes: 1) The damage of a tick is the initial damage multiplied by the number of the tick. Damage is not affected by how long the target has been in the AoE.

fields.notes: All Health gained from this Ability is lost when the 15 seconds expires (this is unlike most similar temporary Health buffs, e.g. Muradin's Avatar and Alexstrasza's Dragonqueen). Spell Power from Soul Harvest stacks additively with itself and other modifiers that can affect Nazeebo's Spell Damage or healing output.
